title: Tracker item
description: One unit of work normalised out of a specific issue tracker (GitHub, Jira, Linear, GitLab) into a provider-independent shape. Flow metrics, forecasting and sprint reporting read this and never the provider payload, so a team can change tracker without rewriting every downstream agent. Every normalised field keeps the raw provider value beside it: normalisation that silently discards what it could not map is a defect.

producedBy.description: agent name that produced this artifact

sourceId.description: native identifier exactly as the provider spells it: "#412", "PROJ-1183", "ENG-77", "group/repo!55".

sourceUrl.description: canonical web URL of the item; the only reliable way for a human to check a claim made about it.

type.description: normalised work type. "unmapped" is required, not optional: a provider type with no honest equivalent is reported as unmapped rather than forced into the nearest bucket.

nativeType.description: provider type verbatim (Jira issuetype.name, GitHub label "type:*", Linear/GitLab equivalent).

state.description: normalised board state. Only "done" counts as delivered; "cancelled" is closed without delivery and must never be counted as throughput.

nativeState.description: provider status verbatim (Jira status.name, GitHub state + "status:*" label, Linear state, GitLab label). Required so a wrong mapping stays auditable.

unit.description: "none" when the item carries no estimate. An absent estimate is never silently read as zero.

parent.description: sourceId of the epic or parent item, when the provider models one.

flow.description: Transition timestamps needed to compute cycle time and work in progress. Absent when the provider's history was not read — which must be stated, because a cycle time computed from createdAt to closedAt is lead time, not cycle time.

historyRead.description: false means the transition timestamps were not available; downstream metrics must degrade to lead time and say so.

tracesTo.description: requirement.v1 ids, ADR numbers or compliance controls this item implements.
